column1: What each enemy says. states: INTRO (battle start) - WINNING (player drops below 20% MS) - LOSING (this enemy drops below 20% MS) - DEFEAT (this enemy dies). A battle picks one persona at random from the rows matching the enemy's emotion, so the same enemy type speaks differently each run. `tier` narrows that: a WEAK or STRONG enemy uses only the rows carrying its own tier, and everything else uses the rows where tier is BLANK. Blank means ANY tier, not 'no tier'. Give a new persona all four states or it will fall silent at the moment it is missing.

column4: line
LIVE
Thirty years in this flat and they sell it to a fund! I'LL BURN IT DOWN WITH YOU IN IT!
Choke on the ashes! CHOKE ON THEM!
No... my things... my life...
Just let me... lock the door... one last time.
Fourteen hours biking in the rain for three euros! I'LL BREAK YOUR FUCKING LEGS!
Take your luxury takeout and choke on it!
My bike... I can't afford to fix my bike...
The app... it says I'm deactivated...
You think a text message makes up for six months of lies?! I'LL TEAR YOUR THROAT OUT!
Look at me! Look at me when I'm screaming at you!
Stop deflecting... stop making me the crazy one!
I just... wanted the truth.
This isn't your playground! Get out of my neighborhood before I smash your skull!
Go back to your perfect little life!
There are too many of you...
We're being erased...
Three years waiting for papers and you stamp DENIED?! I'LL KILL EVERYONE HERE!
Stamp this! STAMP THIS IN BLOOD!
Please, you don't understand what they'll do to me...
I don't exist anymore...
Look at you, sweating on the metro. Did you even shower before touching my city?
Filth always sinks to the bottom. Stay there.
Don't touch me with those calloused hands!
Your smell... it won't wash off...
Another addict blocking the ATM. Can't you just die somewhere out of sight?
Scrape yourself off my shoes.
Don't bleed on my designer coat!
I am... better than this...
You come here, take our space, speak your garbage language. You make me sick.
Clean it up. That's all you're good for.
How dare you speak back to me?!
This isn't... your home...
Plastic faces, fake lips, empty heads. You're a walking infection in this club.
Choke on your vanity.
Get your cheap perfume away from me.
It's all so... hollow...
I see the track marks under your sleeves. You're rotting from the inside, just like me.
We belong in the gutter. Accept it.
Don't look at me with pity!
Just... one more hit to make it stop...
No. Dad didn't leave. Dad loves me... Loved me?
I'll make you stay! Nobody leaves me again!
Did I do something wrong?
I'll be good... I promise I'll be good...
The hospital called. Nobody came to claim his things. Am I next?
If you stay down... it hurts less. I promise.
Why does everyone walk away?
Finally... it's quiet.
My grandfather built this bar. Now it's a fucking brunch spot... I have nothing.
Drink the bitterness. It's all we have left.
They're painting over the mural...
I don't recognize my own street.
The sea was supposed to be calm... they promised it was safe to cross...
Drown with me! Drown with my memories!
I can't hold on to the raft...
The water is so cold...
Ten years playing in the metro... nobody even looks up anymore.
LISTEN TO ME! FOR ONCE IN YOUR LIFE!
My strings are snapping...
Silence... just like always.
Shhhh shhhhhhhhh! Those transphobes behind the corner, they'll notice us, move back slowly... oh no OH NO
STAY BACK! I HAVE A KNIFE!
Please, I just want to walk home...
Not again... please not again...
The cameras on the streetlights—they track our heartbeats. Don't let them see you panic!
I'll blind them! I'LL BLIND THE WHOLE CITY!
They're zooming in... they know my name...
Erase my... search history...
I have the money, I swear! Just give me till Friday!
I'll take yours! I'll pay them with your blood!
They're going to break my hands...
Tell my mother... I'm sorry...
He said he wouldn't hit me again if I just stayed quiet...
Don't make him angry! Just do what he says!
He's coming up the stairs... I can hear his keys...
It was always going to end like this...
Footsteps. Stop. Footsteps. Why are they matching my pace?
I'll run! You can't catch me in the dark!
The streetlights are all broken here...
Nobody can hear me scream...
Life is MINE and this street is MY world to strut by and BLIND YOU WITH MY LIGHT
Bask in my glory! I am untouched by sorrow!
Wait... why is everyone looking at me like that?
The spotlight... it's fading...
Another pill, another party! The sun never sets in Raval if your eyes are wide enough!
DANCE WITH ME! WHY AREN'T YOU DANCING?!
No, no, the comedown... I can't feel my teeth...
It's so dark... where did the music go?
We are all just vibrations! I have transcended this fleshy prison!
Let me cleanse your aura... WITH FIRE!
My chakras... they are bleeding...
The universe... lied to me...
A million followers, baby! Look at this view, look at this life!
SMILE FOR THE CAMERA, TRASH!
I'm losing sponsors... I'm losing relevance...
Did anybody... even like... the post?
Look at how pretty the flames are on the dumpsters! It's art!
BURN! EVERYTHING LOOKS BETTER IN RED!
The smoke... I can't breathe...
Just embers... cold, dead embers...
Yesss YESSSS give me that sweet sweet nectar GIVE IT... wait, what did you just inject me with?
I'LL TEAR THE POISON OUT OF YOUR CHEST!
My heart... it's beating too fast...
You... you killed me...
The light was green! I swear on my mother's life the light was green!
You see it too, right? The glass in my hair?
Why is the steering wheel bending like that?
I can't... feel my legs...
Six months? You're joking, right? I ran a marathon yesterday...
I'M NOT SICK! LOOK AT HOW STRONG I AM!
Why am I coughing blood...?
I don't have enough time...
They're breaking down the door! Throw it in the toilet, NOW!
YOU'LL NEVER TAKE ME ALIVE, PIGS!
The window... it's too high up...
Handcuffs... so cold...
Why won't anybody look at me? I've been screaming on this platform for hours...
FEEL ME! FEEL MY COLD HANDS!
My reflection... I don't have a reflection...
I died... I died under the metro...
I have the paper, I have the locks and I have all morning. OPEN IT.
Everything in here belongs to someone else now. Including you.
I'm just doing my job — I'M JUST DOING MY JOB!
There's another twelve on the list today. Someone else will come.
Disperse. You have been warned. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED!
Nobody filmed this. Nobody ever films this.
Hold the line... hold the LINE...
Badge number... nobody ever asks for the badge number.
Forty families out by Friday and a rooftop pool by spring. Try and stop me.
This whole barri is already sold. You're standing in a render.
The permits — who talked to the press about the permits?!
It was going to be beautiful...
All of it. They're keeping ALL of it. I signed — I SIGNED WHAT?!
Read the small print, they said. READ IT NOW, GO ON!
There has to be an appeal. There's always an appeal...
Fourteen years. In one afternoon.
Whose jacket is this? WHOSE BLOOD IS THIS? Somebody tell me what I did!
You were there! You saw it! SAY WHAT YOU SAW!
It's coming back... oh God, it's coming back...
Don't tell me. Please. Don't ever tell me.
The ceiling was there this morning. IT WAS THERE THIS MORNING!
Nothing holds! Look at it! NOTHING HOLDS!
My hands won't stop. Why won't my hands stop?
Everyone kept saying it was fine.
Fourth night. The train's warm, that's all. Don't make me move.
You get used to the noise. You never get used to the light.
I only wanted to close my eyes...
Wake me at Fondo. Somebody always does.
Delivered. Two blue ticks, eleven days ago. That's the whole story.
Everyone's busy. Everyone's always so busy.
Maybe she's just... maybe the phone...
I'll type it again tonight. I won't send it.
Everybody left for Berlin, Lisbon, anywhere. I locked up.
You'll go too. They all go.
It's only me on this platform now...
Somebody has to stay and turn the lights off.
Six in the morning and the night's still GOING! Come on, one more, ONE MORE!
This is living! THIS IS LIVING! Where's my phone?
Wait — wait, has anyone got water...
I'll be fine. I've got work at nine. I'll be fine.
Eleven of us, matching sashes, and NOBODY is going home sad tonight!
Smile! SMILE! It's meant to be the best day of her life!
Where's Marta? Has anyone seen Marta?
She cried in the toilets for an hour. We got the photos though.
Same four chords for nine years and the carriage still claps! Listen!
They're LOVING this! Look at them! They're loving it!
Two euros. Whole carriage. Two euros...
Next stop's better. Next stop's always better.
End of the line. Everybody off. EVERYBODY OFF, I said!
Forty years I've turned this train around. You'll not be the one that stops me.
There's no more track. There's no more TRACK!
Somebody has to be here when it ends. It was always going to be me.
Wait. Wait — what time is it? What DAY is it? Who let the light in?!
It's not over! It was never over! One more, come on, ONE MORE!
My heart's doing something. My heart's doing something wrong—
Take it. Take the lot. I never want to feel that good again.
Ohmygod hiii! Okay so — you're kind of ruining the vibe right now? Smile.
This city is literally MY brunch and you are literally not invited!
No no no, this isn't — I don't DO bad days. Somebody fix this. FIX IT!
Fine. FINE. Keep your stupid little line. I'm moving to Lisbon anyway.
You don't GET it. You can't beat me — I AM the good time. I am every rooftop in this city. I AM JOY.
...it was such a good year. It was such a good, good year.
